issues.explanation: The draft says lens R4 is amber glass at 18点 on the same day, but the record shows the western aperture lens — which the index identifies as lens R4 at that same 18点 — is clear glass, not amber glass.

evidence.excerpt: At 18点 on the same day, the observatory index identifies lens R4 as the installed western aperture lens.
At 18点 on the same day, the western aperture lens is clear glass, not amber glass.

issues.reasoning: Evidence span basalt_observatory-1 supplies the identity premise at the same anchor: at 18点 on the same day the index identifies lens R4 as the installed western aperture lens. Span basalt_observatory-2 then states that the western aperture lens is clear glass, not amber glass at 18点 on the same day. With the same object (R4 = western aperture lens) and the same explicit time (18点, same day), the two glass descriptions cannot both hold, so the draft claim cannot coexist with the cited record.

suggested_revision.before: At 18点 on the same day, lens R4 is amber glass.
suggested_revision.after: At 18点 on the same day, lens R4, the installed western aperture lens, is clear glass, not amber glass.
